name: veriscope
description: VeriScope — a free, privacy-first, evidence-first fact-checking Chrome extension. Verifies claims against transparent evidence with honest uncertainty. No paid APIs, no tracking, local-by-default.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.sw.config.ts && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && node scripts/emit-manifest.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
